Momentum rank is a focus lens only, and the validated edge is drawdown control on eligible themes, not return forecasting.
emerging_watch: Watching whether rotation breadth widens beyond the current 4 eligible themes (frac 0.24, view=narrow). A confirmed broadening handoff — e.g. High-Dividend Blue Chips or Conglomerates & Exchange gaining eligible status while Banks holds — would retire the narrow-ledership read.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the eligible trend-gated cohort, with the highest durability bar and wide breadth, and the absolute-trend gate is active (eligible=true).
